subject.title: Style test 02 - basic shading / low detail

canon.silhouette: ragged and irregular - mismatched scavenged gear breaks the outline: one bulky pauldron against one thin bandaged arm, a head capped on one side only, a torso split cloth-against-plate, mismatched legs, and an off-vertical improvised club leaving the body outline
canon.reads_as: a patched, uneven person pressed into a rank - motley, never uniform

prompt.description: A ragged militia footman in mismatched scavenged gear, stocky and small-limbed with an oversized head. A battered metal skullcap sits low over one side of the head; the other side is bare scalp and an open face. One shoulder carries a bulky salvaged pauldron and armoured sleeve; the opposite arm is thin, bare and wrapped in bandages. The chest is half patched cloth jerkin, half a single scavenged breastplate. One leg is booted, the other bare and wrapped. Held low and angled away from the body, an improvised wooden club with an iron-bound head. Nothing matches.
must_include: uneven shoulder line - one bulky pauldron sitting higher, one thin bandaged arm sitting lower
skullcap covering only one side of the head, bare scalp and open face on the other
torso split down the middle, patched cloth on one side and a single scavenged plate on the other
one booted leg and one bare wrapped leg
improvised club held at an off-vertical angle, its far end clear of the body outline
two dark eye recesses in an open face
must_avoid: closed helmet, visor, faceplate, crest or plume
symmetrical shoulders or a flat level shoulder line
spear, polearm or any weapon held vertically
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
white or near-white highlights, specular glints
